title: Package-Zone Loitering Before Pickup
dataSources: Object detections (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm state changes (`alarm:event`), smart-lock access (`lock:access`), plate and gate events (`gate:event`), and doorbell delivery telemetry (`doorbell:event`).
app: Home-security telemetry from Frigate and Blue Iris detections, camera health feeds, smart locks, alarm panels, doorbells, and gate sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and Home Assistant integrations.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=frigate:event label="person" zone="porch"
| stats avg(dwell_sec) as avg_dwell_sec max(dwell_sec) as max_dwell_sec by camera
| where max_dwell_sec>60
| sort - max_dwell_sec
description: Highlights people who linger unusually long in the porch package zone before an item is retrieved.
value: Loiter time is a useful context signal for delivery theft risk because it distinguishes quick drop-offs from suspicious hovering.
implementation: Tag package-zone detections in Frigate and store dwell time for each tracked person event.
visualization: Bar chart of maximum porch loiter time by camera.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks when someone hangs around a package area much longer than normal, which can be a warning sign.
